headline: Revenue and margins accelerate on LTL yield gains
summary_short: XPO's second-quarter 2026 revenue rose 13.2% y/y to $2.4 billion and net income jumped 52.8% y/y to $162 million ($1.36 diluted EPS), led by a 15.2% revenue increase in the North American LTL segment on higher yield and tonnage.
summary_long: North American LTL revenue grew 15.2% y/y to $1.4B on higher yield (+4.4% to $26.09/cwt), higher tonnage, and $131M more fuel surcharge revenue; segment adjusted EBITDA rose to $390M from $300M. European Transportation revenue grew 10.2% to $927M on improved pricing, FX, and fuel revenue, with adjusted EBITDA of $48M vs $44M. Operating expenses fell as a share of revenue despite wage inflation and fuel costs, aided by AI-driven productivity gains. Interest expense fell to $51M on debt repayment. Cash was $298M vs $310M at year-end 2025; the company repurchased $70M of stock in the quarter ($525M remaining authorization). Full-year 2026 gross capex guidance stands at $500-600M.
